name: PEM
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 利用等效确定性激励求取随机振动频域响应的方法。
usage_overview: 在车辆—轨道等系统的线性或线性化随机振动分析中，构造与随机激励谱对应的确定性复谐波虚拟激励，以求取响应功率谱、减少随机样本计算，也可作为频域分析结果的比较基准。

complete_examples.text: In this part, a pseudo-excitation method (PEM), theoretically applicable for linear systems, is applied to achieve the random analysis of vehicle-track systems.
By applying Monte Carlo method (MCM), the results of PEM are compared to those derived by the linear and nonlinear computations in MCM, as shown in Fig. 7.
Therefore, the PEM introduced can efficiently prompt the analytical procedures.
However, the sampling number used in MCM is significantly larger than that of PEM, i.e. 2000 vs. 74.
